Dropdown/project label font is 11px to match scope-tab typography. Icons are approximately 12–13px. Preserve readable focus, hover, and menu behavior.

Reduce surrounding vertical spacing so total toolbar band is <=26px where practical; no hidden theme/default minimum may inflate it. Use shrinkWrap, visualDensity, or constraints as needed on the actual rendered outer controls.

Update failing-first test to measure the outer rendered selector/add/sort/refresh widgets and toolbar band, not only an inner container. Assert 24px controls, equal centers, total band <=26px. Scope tabs remain unchanged.

Remove accidental nested horizontal padding if it is not intentional (_ByProjectSelector currently adds horizontal 12 inside an outer row already padded 12); keep coherent 12px outer inset and modest inter-control gaps.

Match TOOLS heading tokens: 10px, weight 700, muted accessible color, ~0.8 letter spacing, compact transparent heading treatment. Hover/focus can reveal restrained state; no pills/cards.
Agents control toggles `_sessionsExpanded`, hiding/showing SessionListBody and multi-select bulk bar while leaving Tools/sticky divider available. Preserve semantics expanded state and count.

Sub Agents control calls existing controller bulk collapse behavior across every visible parent with children: if any expanded, collapse all; otherwise expand all.
